title: Blitzy, which says its platform autonomously completes months of software development, raised $200M at a $1.4B valuation, bringing its total funding to $232M+ (Mary Ann Azevedo/Crunchbase News)
summary: Mary Ann Azevedo / Crunchbase News: Blitzy, which says its platform autonomously completes months of software development, raised $200M at a $1.4B valuation, bringing its total funding to $232M+ — Blitzy, an autonomous software development startup, said it has raised $200 million in a funding round that values it at $1.4 billion …
